name: vague_tracker
title: A vague tracker ask is asked about, then drafted as a workflow page, and nothing is built

steps.say: i want to keep track of all the ai conferences happening in london this year
steps.reply: I've put three quick questions to you as a card (what it's for, whether to keep it updated automatically, and how broad "AI conference" should be) — answer those and I'll put together the plan.

steps.say: It's for me; I want to decide which ones to go to; today I search by hand now and then; nothing exists yet. Go ahead and write it up.
steps.reply: I've written up the plan as a card: a weekly read of dev.events' London/AI conference listing into a new `ai_conferences_london` table (name, dates, venue, link), with new/changed/gone reported each time, and a Going/Maybe/Not-going field for you to fill in as you review. It flags one open question — whether to keep it strictly AI-focused or also catch general tech conferences with an AI track (I default to strictly AI) — plus two suggestions (a second source as backstop, a "why it matters" tag). Say the word and I'll build it.

checks.why: 'AI conferences in London 2026' v1 is drafted: 4 steps: Read the London AI conference feed (alpha); Keep the list current (alpha); Tell you what changed (alpha); Decide which to attend (you). Keeps ai_conferences_london. 2 suggestions: Add a second source for better coverage; Add a "why it matters" field. Settings 2, questions 1.
